DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/AMMO. The ammunition's data, 16 bytes in the original edition and 20 in the Special Edition. [measured: 16 bytes in every DATA field in Skyrim.esm]

BODT.name: Body Template
BODT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/ARMO. The body template, 8 or 12 bytes. [measured: 8 bytes in 9 of Skyrim.esm's records and 12 in the rest]

BODT.name: Body Template
BODT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/RACE. The body template, 12 bytes. The Special Edition carries it in a BOD2 instead. [measured: 12 bytes in every BODT field in Skyrim.esm]

DATA.name: General Race Stats
DATA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/RACE. The race's stats, 128 bytes. The Special Edition's is 164. [measured: 128 bytes in every DATA field in Skyrim.esm]

CRDT.name: Critical Damage
CRDT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/WEAP. The critical damage, the multiplier, the flags and the critical spell. The Special Edition's is 24 bytes. [measured: 16 bytes in every CRDT field in Skyrim.esm]

MNAM.name: Map Size
MNAM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/WRLD. The map's usable width and height and its corner cells. The Special Edition's also carries the camera's height and pitch limits. [measured: 16 bytes in every MNAM field in Skyrim.esm]
